propagates from

  • CURIE: gmeow:propagatesFrom
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/propagatesFrom
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/narrative

The propagation edge linking one myth telling to the telling it was derived from — reusing the PROV-O lineage spine so myth-spread is not a parallel graph (Principle 4). The propagating agent is a gmeow:Participation with roleDupe (unwitting) or roleDeceiver (knowing).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CreativeWork -> gmeow:CreativeWork Sub-property of: gmeow:wasDerivedFrom

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:propagatesFrom from gmeow:CreativeWork to gmeow:CreativeWork when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:wasDerivedFrom, gmeow:CreativeWork
